status: Research checkpoint. No candidate promoted. Search remains open.
qualityTarget: Clean enlargement with source details retained; no added texture or invented structure. Visual screening is subjective, not a ground-truth quality metric.

method.output: Lossless PNG, no post-sharpening or smoothing; one native-scale model pass then browser high-quality resize. 1x models are denoisers followed by resize.
method.timing: Median of one warmed crop measurement per map, including pixel assembly/readback; excludes session creation, reference test, whole-crop pass, encoding and save. Not a full-map or controlled cross-device benchmark.
method.wholeVersusTiled: Difference across the entire native-scale crop, not only a seam and not a perceptual score.
method.outputDigest: SHA256 of sorted-in-map-order lines: filename + space + PNG SHA256 + newline; 2x then 4x, tiled then whole when saved.
method.limits: Five small crops from a related art-style corpus; no high-resolution ground truth. Native correctness and browser compatibility do not establish image quality. Earlier browser runs predate in-worker model hash verification; their exact saved graphs were separately validated natively.
